messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-31415 fired for team=eng-oncall — high pending queue depth on inference-queue-usw2 (backlog > 12k, tail latency > 15s)

sofia: saw spike ~12:20p UTC, clients hitting timeouts and 502s. dashboards show per-route 95p latency at 18s, error rate up 9%

ben: acked PD, I'll take lead. checking autoscaler + cluster events now

pagerduty-bot: PD-31415 acknowledged by ben

ben: quick readout: autoscaler failing to provision nodes due to cloud quota errors. cluster-autoscaler shows repeated failures: 
```
E0615 12:21:34 cloud_provider.go:412] quotaExceeded: Insufficient 'CPUs' quota
E0615 12:21:36 cloud_provider.go:412] quotaExceeded: Insufficient 'CPUs' quota
```

maya: customer-impact: support flagged 3 enterprise customers with degraded requests (tickets #7864, #7867, #7870). some pages and synthetic monitors in EU/US seeing 502/504

alex: trying to create an ephemeral burst pool with a separate quota. running quick patch: `kubectl apply -f ephemeral-pool-10.yaml` — but gcloud calls are returning quota errors too

ben: opened quota request with cloud-ops (supplemental ticket 9982). meanwhile we should enable fallback routing to a smaller model to reduce per-request resource use

sofia: agree. small-model fallback will cut token count and latency. can we flip route for critical routes to rwd/small-v1?

ben: initiating canary override: `POST /internal/routing/override {"route":"/v1/generate","model":"rwd/small-v1","weight":100}` — applying now

ben: routing override applied. shifting 100% on canary (will monitor 1m)

pagerduty-bot: PD-31415 note: escalation to oncall-2 scheduled in 10m if unresolved

maya: observing canary metrics: 95p latency dropped to ~2.3s for routed traffic, error rate for those requests ~0.4% down from 8% :thumbsup:

alex: support update posted to tickets with workaround + ETA 30m for full recovery

ben: enabling prefix KV cache and bumping request concurrency to reduce load while autoscaler stalls: 
```
PATCH /internal/cache/config {"enabled":true,"ttl":300}
PATCH /internal/dispatcher {"max_concurrency":64}
```

sofia: cache enablement in progress — logs show cache warm-up; pending queue dropping

ben: good news: pending queue dropped from 12k -> 1.8k in ~4m after routing + cache. error volume down ~84%

pagerduty-bot: PD-31415 still open; acknowledged by ben, will auto-escalate if state regresses

maya: handing off long-tail follow-up to me (maya). ben, can you collect autoscaler + quota logs for postmortem and drop into the incident doc? I'll own the writeup and customer comms

ben: copying logs to incident doc and notes: root cause appears to be cloud CPU quota exhaustion preventing node provisioning. mitigations: 1) routing fallback to rwd/small-v1 2) enable prefix KV cache 3) manual pool attempts (blocked by quota) 4) increase concurrency settings to smooth throughput

sofia: next steps: confirm quota increase, add an autoscaler circuit-breaker so we fallback earlier, and update on-call runbook to include routing fallback and cache toggle commands. Also add automated PD annotations when autoscaler reports repeated quotaExceeded

maya: created incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PD-31415 — will add timeline, affected customers, and remediation checklist. scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 15:00 UTC

ben: leaving final note in thread: temp mitigations active, cleanup once quota confirmed and nodes healthy. I'll follow up with cloud-ops on the quota ticket

sofia: thanks everyone — I'll mark handoff done. closing thread after postmortem link + followups attached. :white_check_mark:
